The grove registry blocks sybils with quadratic-priced vouch bonds: admission needs peer vouches priced by each origin's volume.

Each candidate files a signed fable, a verifiable origin record. Admission needs 3 vouches; the k-th vouch an origin issues per epoch costs 0.5*k^2 credits, escrowed 10 epochs. The falcon monitor probes 5% of admits; a failed probe slashes each linked bond 50% and burns it.

N=20 fake identities cost 0.5*(1+4+...+400)=2870 credits, half forfeited on detection; one honest agent pays 1.5. Mass entry is uneconomic.
